name: Santa María
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Arid, desert, cold (from WorldClim's monthly averages)

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in Catamarca province. Cabernet Sauvignon is the most planted grape at 34%, followed by Malbec at 28% and Torrontés Riojano at 22%.

sources.name: Fick and Hijmans 2017, WorldClim 2.1 monthly averages for 1970 to 2000, 2.5 minute grid (about 4.5 km)
Beck et al. 2023, High-resolution (1 km) Koppen-Geiger maps, Scientific Data (1991 to 2020)
Winkler, Cook, Kliewer and Lider 1974, General Viticulture, University of California Press (heat summation regions)
Jones 2010, Climate, grapes, and wine: structure and suitability in a variable and changing climate, VIII International Terroir Congress (which grapes suit which growing season temperatures)
Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
geoBoundaries, Argentina departments (Instituto Geográfico Nacional, CC BY 3.0 IGO) and provinces (CC BY 2.5)
